Hannah: I need a 90-minute distraction while I meal-prep tonight. Looking for upbeat tunes + a short show rec. nothing too heavy.
Raj: Music: Jungle 1 "Loving in Stereo" album is great for cooking. TV: 'Ramy' season 1 is only 10 eps, quick and funny.
Olivia: If you want an EP mood, try Arlo Parks 'Collapsed in Sunbeams' 1 gentle and upbeat. For vid: 'Russian Doll' season 1 is bingeable too.
Hannah: Ooh Arlo Parks sounds perfect. Any playlists to queue?
MusicBot: Created playlist "Redwood Quick Cook Vibes" and sent to @Hannah: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/example123 (demo link).
Raj: tiny homemade mix (paste into a queue):
```
1. Jungle - Casio
2. Arlo Parks - Hurt
3. Tame Impala - The Less I Know The Better
4. Khruangbin - Maria También
5. Sylvan Esso - Coffee
```
Olivia: show poll: Ramy vs Russian Doll vs Ramy+Russian Doll split? :thinking_face:
Raj: vote: Russian Doll (fast plot, laughs) :thumbsup:
Hannah: vote: Ramy (feels, good soundtrack) :sparkling_heart:
Olivia: Vote: split watch (do an episode of each during prep) :ok_hand:
Hannah: done. Thanks friends, playlist queued and I'm set.
Raj: enjoy! report back if the tracks survive the spicy stir-fry test.
